**Finding: ASSIGN — compliant (preferred level).**

Section 24 satisfies every preferred element:

- **Customer assignment to Affiliate / successor without consent** — §24.1 (p0098), notice-only condition.
- **Vendor may not assign without our consent; not unreasonably withheld** — §24.2 (p0099), which also captures delegation of material performance and transfer by change of control.
- **No Vendor assignment to a Customer competitor** — §24.2, subject only to our own consent.
- **No Vendor right on our change of control** — §24.4 (p0101) expressly negates termination, suspension, repricing, Fee acceleration and service reduction, closing the walk-away trigger.

Supporting: §24.3 (p0100) mutual consent standard for other assignments, and §13.3 (p0055) licence-transfer right tied to permitted Section 24 assignments. The competitor bar being framed as "without Customer's consent" rather than absolute is a consent right we control — noted, not redlined. No redline proposed.
